title: Account Executive (New Business)
description:
Location: Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)

 

About Us

Our mission is to help organizations turn any engagement idea into an interactive reality.

We see digital interaction as a creative practice, not a static broadcast. Finding and connecting with your audience takes unique content and constant iteration. As AI makes basic video generation faster and tactics easier to copy, hyper-personalized, interactive digital human experiences are the only lasting advantage.

 

We operate with the speed, agility, and culture of a Day 1 team, while being exceptionally well-capitalized and deeply resourced. We have bypassed the typical startup grind of constant fundraising and survival anxiety. Instead, we have immense R&D power, cutting-edge AI infrastructure, and long-term financial stability to focus entirely on one thing: market execution and product innovation.

 

We have perfected our digital human and interactive live-streaming technology. Now, we are aggressively launching our go-to-market motion in the US—and we are looking for builders to lead the charge.

 

What You'll Do

  • Act as a founding GTM pillar in the US: Own and close net-new business end-to-end, helping us establish a strong foothold in the North American market.
  • Prospect into target accounts (forward-thinking brands, agencies, creators) and build a robust pipeline from the ground up.
  • Run tailored product evaluations and demos that connect our digital human capabilities to a prospect's specific content generation and live-streaming workflows.
  • Lead consultative discovery that helps early-adopter prospects see the ROI and creative possibilities of our platform.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Leadership teams to channel US market feedback directly into our product roadmap.
  • Help build our US sales playbook, processes, and culture as we scale.
  • Use AI creatively, whether to generate personalized outreach videos using our own product or to improve your daily workflows.

What You'll Bring

  • 4+ years in a closing role (AE, Senior AE, or Sales Leader) with a track record of carrying and exceeding quota.
  • Proven ability to hunt and build pipeline from scratch, not just manage inbound leads. You thrive in a "Zero to One" environment.
  • Experience closing new-logo deals in the $50K–$100K range with multiple stakeholders in a consultative, solutions-oriented selling motion.
  • High business IQ: you can walk into a conversation with a brand you've never sold to, quickly understand their marketing, e-commerce, or live-streaming motion, and identify where our platform creates value. This is the single most important skill in the role.
  • Creative and resourceful, whether that's finding clever ways to use AI video tools in your own work or learning and pitching our platform's exciting use cases.
  • Experience with a formal sales methodology (we don't care which one, but you have a structured approach to running deals).
  • You're an entrepreneurial communicator who can hold a room (or a Zoom call) without dominating it.

Why This Role

You get the absolute best of both worlds: the massive upside, equity potential, and creative freedom of an early-stage go-to-market team, completely free from the existential financial dread that usually comes with it.

We believe we're building the future of what great salespeople look like in a post-AI world. You'll get a front-row seat to how the best brands in tech and retail actually operate their next-generation media strategies, and you will be the bridge that brings world-class AI technology to them.

OTE: $170K–$280K | Commission Eligible

title: Design Verification Engineer
description:
Do you want to be part of the AI revolution? Do you want to think out of the box, thriving on challenges in AI industry and have the desire to solve them? Do you want to work with a world-class team to explore the fast-growing AI hardware opportunities and impact on AI industry?

We’re looking forward to you joining us to collaborate, contribute, and revolutionize AI silicon and system.

Description

We are looking for an experienced design verification engineer to join our SoC team at Baidu’s Sunnyvale office. The successful candidate will be a motivated self-starter who will thrive in this highly technical environment. Your job responsibilities as a Design Verification Engineer will help the team to verify the functionality of Baidu's AI SoC at both block level and SoC level.

You will help on UVM Testbench development, directed/constrained random test generation, failure analysis and resolution, coverage analysis, and flow development.

Run RTL and gate level functional verification, debug failures, lead bug tracking, and analyze and close coverage.

Work closely with the design and systems engineering teams to review specifications and architecture, extract features, define verification plan & coverage model.

Support mixed-signal co-simulation using Verilog models of analog IP. Develop testbench, test cases, reference model, coverage model and automation of regression suite.

Support emulation and silicon bring up debug with your smart ideas to duplicate the problem in simulation.

Qualifications 

  • Minimum 5 years of experience of UVM based verification on a significantly complex project.
  • Advanced knowledge of standard ASIC design and verification flows, simulation and testbench development.
  • Advanced knowledge of System Verilog and the UVM methodology.
  • Solid verification skills in problem solving, constrained random testing, coverage closure, gate level simulations, X propagation.
  • Good practice of one scripting language (Perl, Python, Tcl) no preference.
  • SoC and IP verification experience on either one aspect (PCIe, Ethernet, HBM, GDDR, DDR, MMU, Cache).
  • Familiar with C/C++.
  • Formal Verification (Model Checking, Equivalence Checking).
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Chinese.

You’ll work directly with customers to understand their use cases, design solutions, build prototypes, troubleshoot integrations, and help move applications from early testing to production.
 
This is a full-time, on-site internship based in the Bay Area. The initial internship period is 3 months, with the possibility to extend based on performance and business needs.
 
This is a highly hands-on engineering role. You should be comfortable writing code, working with APIs, debugging technical issues, and communicating directly with customers. You’ll also work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Business teams to bring customer feedback back into the product.
 

What You’ll Do

  • Work directly with customers to understand their technical requirements, architecture, and use cases.
  • Help customers integrate Querit Search API into AI agents, RAG systems, research tools, and other AI applications.
  • Build demos, prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and reference implementations for customer use cases.
  • Debug technical issues across API integrations and help customers move from evaluation to production.
  • Advise customers on search quality, latency, retrieval strategies, and integration best practices.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to identify recurring customer needs, technical blockers, and opportunities to improve the product.
  • Create reusable sample code, integration guides, demos, and technical documentation.
  • Work closely with the business team during technical evaluations, customer onboarding, and deployment.
  • Communicate with developers, founders, and engineering teams during customer-facing technical discussions.

What We’re Looking For

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or a similar language.
  • Experience working with REST APIs, backend systems, or web applications.
  • Familiarity with modern AI application stacks, including LLMs, RAG, agents, or retrieval systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to debug technical issues independently.
  • Comfortable communicating directly with customers and explaining technical concepts clearly.
  • Strong communication skills and a proactive, ownership-driven working style.
  • Able to work full-time and on-site from our Bay Area office for at least 3 months.

Nice to Have

  • Previous software engineering, AI, or technical internship experience.
  • Experience building AI agents, RAG pipelines, search, or retrieval systems.
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, OpenAI SDKs, or similar tools.
  • Experience with developer tools, APIs, AI infrastructure, or enterprise software.
  • Experience building and shipping side projects, hackathon projects, or production applications.

title: Forward Deployment Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are a leading Internet company launching a new, high‑priority business initiative in North America. We are building a greenfield US delivery team and looking for a Forward Deployment Engineer who will act as the primary bridge between our product and our enterprise clients.

Unlike traditional engineering roles, this position is customer‑centric: you will be responsible for the end‑to‑end delivery experience—from onboarding and integration through ongoing adoption and value realization. Your success is measured not by lines of code, but by customer satisfaction, retention, and expansion. You will work closely with client stakeholders (both technical and business) to ensure our AI‑powered solutions are deployed smoothly, adopted widely, and deliver tangible business outcomes.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys solving real‑world problems, has a knack for translating technical concepts into business language, and takes pride in making customers successful.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the Delivery Journey: Lead customer onboarding, deployment planning, and integration execution for new enterprise clients.
  • Customer Success Management: Proactively monitor customer health, usage patterns, and satisfaction; drive adoption campaigns and quarterly business reviews.
  • Needs Discovery: Work with client teams to understand their business goals, technical constraints, and success criteria – then define the optimal deployment approach.
  • Collaborative Integration: Coordinate with internal engineering and product teams to deliver custom integrations (APIs, data pipelines, enterprise platforms) – you will not write production‑grade code from scratch, but you will review, test, and troubleshoot integrations and scripts.
  • Training & Enablement: Conduct technical workshops and training sessions for client administrators and end‑users to ensure self‑sufficiency.
  • Issue Resolution: Act as the first point of contact for technical and operational issues during deployment; escalate complex bugs to engineering while providing clear communication to customers.
  • Voice of the Customer: Synthesize customer feedback and deployment patterns into actionable product improvement suggestions, influencing our product roadmap.

 

What You'll Bring

Experience:

  • 3+ years in a customer‑facing technical role such as Customer Success Engineer, Solutions Consultant, Implementation Consultant, Technical Account Manager, or FDE.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering enterprise software or AI solutions to external clients, managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Experience working directly with non‑technical executives and technical staff (developers, IT ops).

Technical Understanding (not deep coding):

  • Familiarity with modern web technologies (REST APIs, cloud infrastructure, databases) – enough to read code, debug basic issues, and write simple scripts (Python, JavaScript, or similar).
  • Comfortable with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) at a conceptual level – you know how to deploy services, configure networking basics, and monitor logs.
  • Understanding of AI/ML is a plus (LLMs, agents, RAG), but not mandatory – you can learn on the job.
  • Able to triage technical issues: identify whether it's a configuration, data, or code problem, and route accordingly.

Soft Skills & Customer Success Mindset:

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills – you can explain complex technical concepts to business leaders and translate business needs into technical requirements.
  • Strong empathy and active listening – customers trust you because you understand their pain points.
  • Project management and organizational skills – you can juggle multiple accounts and timelines without dropping the ball.
  • Problem‑solving orientation – you don't shy away from ambiguity and are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.
  • Self‑starter – you thrive in a fast‑paced, greenfield environment with minimal handholding.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Customer Success platforms (Gainsight, Totango, Salesforce) or ticketing systems (Jira, Zendesk).
  • Prior experience in a startup or hyper‑growth environment.
  • Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns (e.g., SFTP, ETL, SOAP, OAuth).
  • Hands‑on experience with any AI/GenAI products – either as a user or implementer.

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + performance bonus/equity.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) with company match.
  • Flexible PTO and remote work arrangements.
  • Early‑hire advantage: Be one of the first US team members, help shape our customer delivery playbook and culture.
  • Opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting‑edge AI and enterprise business – a career‑defining experience.

 

Why This Role?

The FDE title may be technical, but at its core it’s about bridging the gap between innovation and real‑world value. In 2025–2026, companies are moving beyond AI demos – they need people who can deliver results and make customers love the product. This role offers you the autonomy, visibility, and impact that you’d expect from a founding‑level position, without the risk of a true startup. Join us in building something new from the ground up.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.
